title: What to Admit and How to Present: Governing Persistent Memory in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.11188v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Persistent memory can improve personalization in LLM agents but can also induce sycophancy and cross-domain leakage. We distinguish two governance decisions: admission, which determines what recalled information enters the working context, and presentation, which determines how admitted information is expressed. We implement two inference-time designs without retraining: factor-compiled admission (FC), which assesses whole memory entries, and permission-semantic admission (PS), which decomposes entries into typed units; both translate adjudicated attributes into eligibility decisions via deterministic policies. We evaluate on a four-backbone development suite and an external benchmark with four tasks of 300 samples each. translated_title: 何者准入与如何呈现：LLM智能体中持久记忆的治理
translated_abstract: 持久记忆可以提升LLM智能体的个性化能力，但也可能引发谄媚行为和跨域信息泄露。我们区分了两种治理决策：准入决定哪些被召回的信息进入工作上下文，而呈现决定被准入的信息如何表达。我们实现了两种无需重新训练的推理时设计：因子编译准入评估完整的记忆条目，权限语义准入将条目分解为带类型的单元；两者均通过确定性策略将裁定的属性转化为资格决策。我们在一个四骨干模型开发套件以及一个包含四个任务（每个任务300个样本）的外部基准上进行评估。相对于逐字注入，FC和PS在外部基准上将裁判评估的汇总失败率分别降低了6.7和8.8个百分点（p = 2.7e-7和4.1e-12），开发集上的跨域泄露降低了
tldr: 该论文提出无需重训练的推理时记忆治理框架，通过区分“准入”与“呈现”两类决策，采用因子编译准入（FC）和权限语义准入（PS）两种设计，显著降低了LLM智能体持久记忆带来的失败率和跨域泄露。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes retraining-free, inference-time memory governance for LLM agents by separating admission from presentation decisions, using factor-compiled admission (FC) and permission-semantic admission (PS) to significantly reduce failure rates and cross-domain leakage from persistent memory.
